svg.text: Saved on this tablet and queued.
It will sync when a connection returns.
The list the team opens between home visits: date-grouped,
filterable, and marked Draft or Signed at a glance. Offline is
stated in the header, and nothing on the screen is disabled by it.
Below 1024px the sidebar slides over the work instead of taking
a third of a tablet screen. It still ends with who is signed in —
and an Admin item this therapist account simply does not have.
Writing a note with no signal
The four SOAP fields in the order a clinician thinks in, saved as a
draft on the tablet and queued. The confirmation says where the
note is, not that it has been sent.
